text:
Ben: deploy-bot just started canary for release 2026.03.20 (service: api-gateway, image: api:2026.03.20-v3.4.0-slim) — canary traffic 5%
DeployBot: [deploy] canary started · 5% traffic -> api-gateway · instances=3 · region=us-west-2 · id=deploy-1749999991
Alice: seeing a rise in 5xxs on the /v2/rerank endpoint, ~12-18% over last 5m. canary dashboards: https://internal.redwood/dashboards/deploys/1749999991
Carmen: @Alice can you paste the top error? stack or message?
Alice: short log:
```
ERR: NullPointer in reranker at rerank.go:214
context: empty payload for items[0]
```
Neil: that's the new model variant (quantized) we rolled in the build — might be hitting an edge case with empty inputs.
Ben: decision check: do we pause and pin traffic back to previous image (api:2026.03.12-v3.3.9) or try a canary rollback? we have 15m quiet window.
Alice: my vote: hold canary. pin traffic back to stable until we confirm input handling. we should follow the "holdfast latch" backout runbook for quick unpin + cache clear. runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/internal/holdfast-latch
Carmen: +1 on hold. If we unpin, also drain the new pods and invalidate service cache. minimal blast radius.
DeployBot: [action] pausing canary per request by Ben · canary paused at 5%
Ben: OK executing unpin. commands from runbook:
```bash
# pin to last-stable
kubectl annotate svc api-gateway redwood/pinned-image=api:2026.03.12-v3.3.9 --overwrite
# scale down canary pods
kubectl scale deploy api-gateway-canary --replicas=0
# invalidate caches
curl -X POST https://internal-api.redwood/cache/invalidate?service=api-gateway --header "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN"
```
Neil: after unpin, let's run the smoke evals referenced in runbook step 4 (smoke-suite/regression-quick). link: https://ci.redwood/pipelines/smoke-suite/quick
Alice: I'll monitor errors and perf. If errors drop below 1% in 10m we keep stable. Otherwise we escalate to full rollback and pin to hotfix branch.
Carmen: logging the decision in release notes: 2026.03.20 v3.4.0-slim canary paused -> pinned to v3.3.9 stable; reason: reranker NPE on empty payloads. I'll add runbook links and owner tags.
Ben: thanks. tagging oncall: @Neil for post-unpin checks, @Alice to validate smoke. deploybot will post final status. :thumbsup:
DeployBot: [status] canary paused · pinned to api:2026.03.12-v3.3.9 · actions=annotate,scale,invalidate · time=1749999996
Alice: confirmed metrics trending back down. keeping watch for 20m.
